SELECT rating AS star, COUNT(*) AS count FROM review WHERE dish_id = #{dishId} AND is_hidden = 0 GROUP BY rating

(SELECT 'dish' AS type, d.id AS id, d.name AS name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.images, '$[0]')) AS image FROM dish d WHERE d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND d.status = 'on' AND (d.audit_status = 'approved' OR d.audit_status IS NULL) LIMIT 5) UNION ALL (SELECT 'stall' AS type, s.id AS id, s.name AS name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.images, '$[0]')) AS image FROM stall s WHERE s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND s.status = 'open' AND (s.audit_status = 'approved' OR s.audit_status IS NULL) LIMIT 5) UNION ALL (SELECT 'canteen' AS type, c.id AS id, c.name AS name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.images, '$[0]')) AS image FROM canteen c WHERE c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND c.status = 'open' LIMIT 5)

SELECT d.name AS keyword, CAST((d.view_count * 1 + d.rating_count * 5 * 20 + COALESCE(d.avg_rating, 0) * 20) AS SIGNED) AS heat FROM dish d WHERE d.status = 'on' AND (d.audit_status = 'approved' OR d.audit_status IS NULL) ORDER BY heat DESC LIMIT 10

WHERE d.status = 'on' AND s.status = 'open' AND c.status = 'open' AND (d.audit_status = 'approved' OR d.audit_status IS NULL) AND d.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) ORDER BY (d.rating_count * 20 + d.view_count) DESC LIMIT 10
